data.name: UsbipMissingText
data.value: Arcadia creates the virtual controller through this driver. The installation asks once for administrator rights.

data.name: UsbipOutdatedText
data.value: {installed} is installed, at least {minimumVersion} is needed.

data.name: UsbipInactiveText
data.value: The driver is installed but not loaded. A PC restart usually helps, otherwise reinstalling it.

data.name: PanMissingText
data.value: Pan gives back the real controllers if Arcadia crashes or hangs. Without Pan, Arcadia can’t bring the Steam Controller into games as an Xbox Controller. The installation asks once for administrator rights.

data.name: HidHideTooOldText
data.value: An older HidHide is installed (driver {installed}); Arcadia needs HidHide {version} or newer. “Update” installs HidHide {version}; your HidHide settings are kept. The installation asks once for administrator rights.

data.name: HidHideTooNewText
data.value: HidHide {installed} is installed; so far Arcadia only knows HidHide {supportedMajorVersion}.x. An Arcadia update will bring support for it.

data.name: HidHideMissingText
data.value: With HidHide, Arcadia hides the real Steam Controller from Steam and other programs while it passes the controller on itself. The installation asks once for administrator rights.

data.name: RemovalAsk
data.value: Also remove the drivers for the controller emulation?

data.name: RemovalOtherPrograms
data.value: Other programs that use them (such as DS4Windows with HidHide) will stop working.

data.name: RemovalAdmin
data.value: Arcadia asks once for administrator rights for this.

data.name: RemovalSteamRestarts
data.value: Steam is closed briefly and started again for this.

data.name: RemovalTimeout
data.value: Without an answer within {seconds} seconds, everything stays installed; Arcadia is uninstalled anyway.

data.name: RemovalRestartNeeded
data.value: The drivers for the controller emulation are only fully removed after the next PC restart.

data.name: RemovalRestartBeforeReinstall
data.value: Restart the PC before you install Arcadia again.

data.name: RestartPendingText
data.value: Arcadia restarts after the HidHide installation

data.name: HidHideReinstallWhileHidden
data.value: HidHide can’t be reinstalled while Pan hides the Steam Controller. Turn off the controller guard (Pan), then try again.

data.name: SteamWontClose
data.value: Steam couldn’t be closed. Close Steam yourself, then try again.

data.name: FirmwareUpdateBlocksInstall
data.value: No drivers can be installed while a firmware update of your controllers is running. Finish the update, then try again.

data.name: DriversBusy
data.value: Installing drivers – please confirm the administrator prompt…

data.name: DriversInstallDeclined
data.value: The installation was declined in the administrator prompt – choose “Install” again and confirm the prompt.

data.name: WindowsRestartFirst
data.value: An uninstalled driver is waiting for the PC restart. Restart the PC; after that, the missing parts can be installed.

data.name: HidHideReinstallWrongVersion
data.value: “Reinstall” only works with HidHide {version}; a different version is installed.

data.name: HidHideReinstallDeclined
data.value: The installation was declined in the administrator prompt – choose “Reinstall” again and confirm the prompt.

data.name: DriverInstallBlockerSteamGame
data.value: A running Steam game ({game}) was detected. Close it first, since Steam has to be closed briefly for the installation.

data.name: PanUpdatingReason
data.value: Pan is being updated – Arcadia reconnects only afterwards

data.name: RestoringReason
data.value: Controllers are being restored – Arcadia reconnects only afterwards

data.name: OldPanOffReason
data.value: Pan isn’t updated and is turned off – Arcadia doesn’t talk to it

data.name: RestoringBusy
data.value: Restoring controllers – please confirm the administrator prompt…

data.name: RestoreDeclined
data.value: The restore was declined in the administrator prompt.

data.name: RestartRefusedTitle
data.value: The PC can’t restart right now

data.name: RestartRefusedText
data.value: Another program or a system setting prevents the restart. Try again in a moment or restart the PC from the Start menu.

data.name: DriversInstallNoAnswer
data.value: The driver installation didn’t answer within {seconds:0} seconds.

data.name: InstallTookTooLong
data.value: {what} took longer than {minutes:0} minutes – the installation was canceled.

data.name: ViiperMissingText
data.value: VIIPER passes the signals of the virtual controllers on to games and programs. “Install” downloads the checked version, without administrator rights.

data.name: ViiperSubtitle
data.value: Passes the controllers’ signals on to games and programs

data.name: PanFailingText
data.value: Pan ends right after it starts. “Set up again” reinstalls Pan and creates its folder anew; why it ended is in {logPath}. The installation asks once for administrator rights.

data.name: HidHideRemovalPending
data.value: HidHide was uninstalled and is fully removed after the next PC restart.

data.name: PausedSummary
data.value: Restart the PC; after that, you can install the missing parts.

data.name: PausedText
data.value: A driver was uninstalled. It is only fully removed after the next PC restart.

data.name: PausedMore
data.value: Until then, Pan is paused: Arcadia doesn’t virtualize or hide any controllers, and games and Steam see your controllers directly. The switch stays on; after the restart, Pan carries on by itself.

data.name: PausedBoxText
data.value: If something is still missing then, it shows here with “Install”. One press sets up everything missing in one go, with one administrator prompt.

data.name: RecommendedSummary
data.value: Restart the PC so the new driver is fully active.

data.name: RecommendedText
data.value: A driver was reinstalled. Pan is already running, but the driver is only fully active after a PC restart.

data.name: RecommendedMore
data.value: Until then, a virtual controller may drop out briefly; Arcadia then reconnects it by itself.

data.name: RecommendedBoxText
data.value: The restart can wait until it suits you. The row stays until the PC has restarted.

data.name: FirmwareUpdateRunsText
data.value: To keep your controllers safe, the drivers can’t be installed while a firmware update of your controllers is running. Finish the update before you install the drivers.

data.name: FirmwareUpdateRunsSubtitle
data.value: Drivers can’t be installed during a firmware update

data.name: SisrRunningText
data.value: SISR is running while Pan is on. Both access the Steam Controller, so games get inputs twice or not at all. Close SISR, or turn off Pan while you need SISR.

data.name: SisrRunningSubtitle
data.value: Close SISR so inputs don’t arrive twice

data.name: HidHideInactiveText
data.value: HidHide is installed, but its driver isn’t running yet. A PC restart usually helps.

data.name: HidHideUnknownRequestText
data.value: The HidHide driver doesn’t know a request Pan needs. “Reinstall” installs HidHide {version}; its settings are kept. Arcadia asks once for administrator rights.

data.name: HidHideInverseText
data.value: “Inverse application cloak” is turned on in HidHide. That way, Arcadia can’t hide the Steam Controller. Turn it off in the HidHide configuration.

data.name: HidHideHidingOffText
data.value: Devices are listed in HidHide, but “Enable device hiding” is off. Arcadia would have to turn it on and would then hide these devices too, so it doesn’t. Turn it on in the HidHide configuration or remove the devices there.

data.name: HidHideConfigOpenText
data.value: While the HidHide configuration is open, Arcadia can’t use HidHide. Please close it.

data.name: DownloadNoChecksum
data.value: No checksum is published for {asset} – download canceled.

data.name: DownloadChecksumWrong
data.value: The checksum of {asset} doesn’t match – download discarded.

data.name: PanOtherProtocol
data.value: Pan speaks a different protocol (Arcadia: {protocolVersion}); Pan needs an update

data.name: PanClosedAfterError
data.value: Connection to Pan closed after an error

data.name: PanPaused
data.value: Pan: controller guard paused. The real controllers are no longer hidden.

data.name: PanRunningAgain
data.value: Pan: controller guard is running again

data.name: PanEmulationStopped
data.value: Pan: emulation stopped – it failed several times in a row. “Try again” in the controller settings restarts it.

data.name: PanRetryFailed
data.value: Pan: trying again didn’t work. What’s missing is shown in the controller settings.

data.name: PanRetryNoController
data.value: Pan: no controller connected, there’s nothing to virtualize.

data.name: PanRetryExcluded
data.value: Pan: Steam Controller and puck stay excluded.

data.name: FirmwareUpdateReason
data.value: Steam is installing a firmware update

data.name: PanNotVisible
data.value: Pan: Arcadia no longer sees the hidden controllers and has released them. Restart Arcadia; the controller settings offer to do that.

data.name: PanCannotHideSteamController
data.value: Pan can’t hide the Steam Controller – update Pan

data.name: PanReleasedForFirmware
data.value: Steam Controller and puck released for a firmware update

data.name: PanCopyNotRemovable
data.value: The copy can’t be removed cleanly

data.name: PanHandOverEnded
data.value: Pan ended the installation before Arcadia could hand over the installers. Nothing was changed – please choose “Install” again.

data.name: PanRestoreHandOverEnded
data.value: Pan ended the restore before Arcadia could release it. Nothing was changed – please choose “Restore controllers” again.

data.name: PanDataFolderNotSaved
data.value: Pan couldn’t back up its data folder {dataDirectory} – please check or remove the folder and try again.

data.name: PanCleanupIncomplete
data.value: Pan couldn’t clean up everything – the journal is kept; details are in {logPath}. Restarting Pan or “Pan.exe --restore” tries again.

data.name: PanHidHideNotInstalled
data.value: Pan is set up, but HidHide isn’t – details are in {logPath}. You can also install HidHide yourself: {url}

data.name: PanRemovedDriverLeft
data.value: Pan is removed, but not every driver – details are in {logPath}; the rest can be removed under Windows Settings → Apps.

data.name: PanCommandFailed
data.value: Pan {command} reported error {exitCode} – details are in {logPath}.

data.name: PanUnreachableAborted
data.value: Pan couldn’t be reached after {seconds:0} seconds – {what} was canceled, nothing has changed.

data.name: PanMissingInBundle
data.value: Pan is missing in Arcadia’s program folder ({path}) – reinstalling Arcadia fixes this.

data.name: PanEndsAtOnce
data.value: Pan ends right after it starts

data.name: ControllersForGamesViiperGaveUp
data.value: Controllers for games: the controller emulation failed {count} times in {minutes:0} minutes; Arcadia only tries again after a restart or “Restore controllers”

data.name: SisrStopFailed
data.value: SISR.exe can’t be closed, so its files stay. Restart the PC, then try again.

data.name: SisrSteamRunning
data.value: Steam was running, so the “SISR Marker” entry stays. Try again.

data.name: SisrRemovalBlocker
data.value: “{game}” is running through Steam right now. Close the game first, then Arcadia can remove SISR.

data.name: SteamControllerForGamesViiperGaveUp
data.value: Steam Controller for games: the controller emulation failed {count} times in {minutes:0} minutes; Arcadia only tries again after a restart or “Restore controllers”

data.name: NoCheckedViiperVersion
data.value: This Arcadia version has no checked VIIPER version.

data.name: PanHandOverNotOurs
data.value: The handover to Pan doesn’t belong to the Pan that was started (process {server} instead of {started}) – {what} was canceled.

data.name: UsbipVersionUnknown
data.value: The current usbip-win2 version couldn’t be determined.

data.name: PanOnlyOnWindows
data.value: Pan is only available on Windows

data.name: CopyNotAttached
data.value: Copy for Steam not attached after {seconds:0} s

data.name: CopyNotSupported
data.value: This Arcadia version can’t copy the Steam Controller for Steam yet

data.name: PuckCableMissing
data.value: The Steam Controller on the cable isn’t there (or Arcadia isn’t on HidHide’s list)

data.name: PuckMissing
data.value: The Steam Controller’s puck isn’t there (or Arcadia isn’t on HidHide’s list)

data.name: PuckSerialInvalid
data.value: The puck reports an invalid serial number

data.name: ViiperCannotBind
data.value: viiper.exe couldn’t be tied to Arcadia so it ends with it (error {error})

data.name: ViiperPortsTimeout
data.value: viiper.exe isn’t listening on both ports after {seconds:0} s

data.name: SteamControllerDescriptionMissing
data.value: The Steam Controller’s description is missing in Arcadia ({file})

data.name: PuckSerialUnreadable
data.value: The puck’s serial number can’t be read

data.name: PuckNotClosed
data.value: The puck couldn’t be closed; the copy hasn’t ended safely

data.name: PuckCallHangs
data.value: A call to the puck doesn’t end; the copy hasn’t ended safely
